subject.title: fix(control-ui): resolve Personal card avatar 401 via data URI

question: Should maintainers repair this narrow conflicting PR, or consolidate the linked avatar-401 work around the broader open PR once its SDK-surface blocker is fixed?
rationale: Automation can identify the mechanical blockers, but choosing the canonical landing vehicle among overlapping avatar PRs requires maintainer coordination.

options.title: Repair this narrow PR
options.body: Keep this branch as the landing vehicle only if the contributor rebases, fixes the type blocker, ports the UI change to current files, and supplies inspectable browser proof.

options.title: Consolidate on the broader PR
options.body: Use the broader open PR as the canonical fix after its public SDK export blocker is repaired, then close or supersede this branch.

options.title: Ask for a fresh narrow PR
options.body: Close the overlapping stale branches and ask for one current-main PR that fixes only the identity/Personal-card avatar mismatch with proof and tests.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on the broader PR
recommendation.body: Use the broader open PR as the canonical fix after its public SDK export blocker is repaired, then close or supersede this branch.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history signal across the affected Gateway/UI avatar code and the related SDK-boundary review context.
